methods.denominators: completed model exits other than Submitted score 0; cells without a terminal attempt are excluded from means and counted
methods.minimum_data: a contrast with fewer than 20 contributing families is exploratory
methods.missing_cells: item-condition means use completed cells; bounds impute 0 and then 1 for each missing cell, plus the directional extremes
methods.primary_test: two-sided one-sample t test on family mean differences (df = F - 1); Holm over the fixed family H1, H2, H3 (the Holm family is always every preregistered hypothesis (H1, H2, H3); a hypothesis that is not estimable enters Holm with p = 1 and its own adjusted p is reported as null); 95% t intervals are marginal
methods.secondary: descriptive estimates with nominal 95% family-clustered intervals, no significance claims, never promoted
methods.seeds: a seed is complete when every P cell is terminal (completed model exit or missing (infrastructure) after the retry cap); the primary seeds are the longest complete prefix of the seed order
methods.sensitivity: sign-flip test (exact when F <= 20, else 100000 draws, seed 20261101, p = (1 + hits) / (1 + draws)); family cluster percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20261101)
methods.symmetry_assumption: The sign-flip test assumes that under the null hypothesis each family's mean paired difference is symmetric about zero and that families are independent.
methods.unit: item mean over the primary seeds (completed cells) -> paired difference within item -> family mean -> equal-weight mean over families
methods.zero_variance: all family differences 0: p = 1, degenerate interval (not equivalence); identical nonzero differences: t undefined, the sign-flip p is used
